title: Awesome monthly tea subscription box!
text: Nice variety of good quality teas. I enjoy that I can try different types of loose leaf each month without having to commit to buying a large quantity of something I’m not sure of. So far, I have enjoyed all 4 of this month’s selections and look forward to trying others! Came with 4 reusable linen teabags and an insert describing the teas-tasting info and specified brewing times. The linen bags are nice, especially if this is your first time trying loose leaf and don’t have the supplies. I have stainless steel tea balls that I prefer to use, as  they’re a bit easier to clean out. The big thing for me is this company helping the developmentally disabled, that alone makes this subscription worth it. Definitely recommend.
label: positive
